                    <script type="text/javascript" data-name="gdprScript">
    const consentAge = 18;
    const cookies = document.cookie.split(';');
    let pidValue = '';
    let hasPidCoppa = false;
    let isLoggedIn = false;
    
    for (let i = 0; i < cookies.length; i++) {
        const cookie = cookies[i].trim();
        if (cookie.startsWith('pid=')) {
            pidValue = cookie.substring(4);
            isLoggedIn = pidValue.charAt(0).toLowerCase() === 'l';
        }
        if (cookie.startsWith('pid_coppa=')) {
            hasPidCoppa = true;
        }
    }
    
    function getCookie(name) {
        const v = document.cookie.match('(^|;) ?' + name + '=([^;]*)(;|$)');
        return v ? v[2] : null;
    }
    
    function setCookie(name, value, days) {
        let expires = '';
        const domain = '.cbssports.com';
        if (days) {
            const date = new Date();
            date.setTime(date.getTime() + days * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
            expires = '; expires=' + date.toUTCString();
        }
        document.cookie = name + '=' + (value || '') + expires + '; path=/; domain=' + domain + ';';
    }
    
    function getAge() {
        try {
            const cookie = getCookie('pid_coppa');
    
            // Early return if no cookie exists
            if (!cookie) {
                console.log('GDPR: No pid_coppa cookie found');
                return 99;
            }
    
            // Validate cookie is not empty and looks like base64
            if (typeof cookie !== 'string' || cookie.trim() === '') {
                console.warn('GDPR: Cookie value is empty');
                return 99;
            }
    
            // Check if cookie is valid base64
            if (!isValidBase64(cookie)) {
                console.warn('GDPR: Cookie is not valid base64');
                return 99;
            }
    
            // Decode the base64 cookie value
            let decodedCookie;
            try {
                decodedCookie = atob(cookie);
            } catch (decodeError) {
                console.error('GDPR: Failed to decode cookie', decodeError);
                return 99;
            }
    
            // Parse the cookie structure (expecting format: value@age)
            const splitCookie = decodedCookie.split('@');
    
            if (splitCookie.length < 2) {
                console.warn('GDPR: Invalid cookie format - missing age component');
                return 99;
            }
    
            const ageString = splitCookie[1];
    
            // Validate age exists and is not empty
            if (!ageString || ageString.trim() === '') {
                console.warn('GDPR: Age component is empty');
                return 99;
            }
    
            // Convert to number and validate
            const age = parseInt(ageString, 10);
    
            if (isNaN(age) || age < 0 || age > 150) {
                console.warn('GDPR: Invalid age value:', ageString);
                return 99;
            }
    
            console.log('GDPR: Valid age found:', age);
            return age;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('GDPR: Unexpected error in getAge function:', error);
            return 99;
        }
    }
    
    /**
     * Check if string is valid base64
     * @param {string} str - String to validate
     * @returns {boolean} - True if valid base64
     */
    function isValidBase64(str) {
        try {
            // Check if string contains only valid base64 characters
            const base64Regex = /^[A-Za-z0-9+/]*={0,2}$/;
    
            if (!base64Regex.test(str)) {
                return false;
            }
    
            // Check if string length is valid for base64 (multiple of 4)
            if (str.length % 4 !== 0) {
                return false;
            }
    
            // Test decode without throwing error
            atob(str);
            return true;
        } catch (e) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    
    // Set up OneTrust object with Privacy Cross-Platform Consent Token
    if (isLoggedIn) {
        const privacyEncodedCookie = getCookie('privacyConsent');
        if (privacyEncodedCookie !== null) {
            try {
                const privacyCookie = decodeURIComponent(privacyEncodedCookie);
                // Parse the JSON string from the cookie value
                const { privacy_id, privacy_jwt } = JSON.parse(privacyCookie);
                // OneTrust object definition
                if (privacy_id && privacy_jwt) {
                    const OneTrust = {
                        dataSubjectParams: {
                            id: privacy_id,
                            isAnonymous: false,
                            token: privacy_jwt,
                        },
                    };
                    window.OneTrust = OneTrust;
                }
            } catch (e) {
                console.error('PKW-Error parsing cookie JSON:', e);
            }
        }
    }
    
    // Create the fly_landingPath cookie if it doesn't exist
    // This is used to determine the entry point landing path for users
    if (!getCookie('fly_landingPath')) {
        const landingPath = window.location.origin + window.location.pathname;
        setCookie('fly_landingPath', landingPath, 365);
    }

<article id="Article-body" class="Article-body">
    <div class="Article-bodyContent">
        <p>Welcome to the rare international break overlap, where men's and women's national teams are in session at the same time, if only for a few days. As women's national teams begin their work before games over the weekend, their counterparts on the men's side are finally wrapping up their oversized international break. The men's window will end with a bang, too – while the U.S. men's national team's youthful revamp continues, Lionel Messi will be Argentina's headliner one last time. I'm Pardeep Cattry with the latest.</p><tr>

    <h3>📺 Footy fix</h3><p><em>All times U.S./Eastern</em></p><p><strong>Monday, Oct. 5<br></strong>🇪🇺 UNL: Italy vs. Turkiye, 2:45 p.m. ➡️ FS2<br>🌎 CNL: Honduras vs. Jamaica, 10 p.m. ➡️ FS2</p><p><strong>Tuesday, Oct. 6<br></strong>🇪🇺 UNL: England vs. Czechia, 2:45 p.m. ➡️ FS2<br>🌎 Friendly: Argentina vs. Benin, 7 p.m. ➡️ Vix<br>🌎 Friendly: USMNT vs. Canada, 8 p.m. ➡️ TNT<br>🇺🇸🇨🇦 MLS: Chicago Fire vs. Vancouver Whitecaps, 8:30 p.m. ➡️ Apple TV</p><h2>🇺🇸 USMNT survive, then thrive against Mexico</h2><figure class="MediaShortcode MediaShortcodeImage none large"><div class="MediaShortcodeImage-image" data-large="https://sportshub.cbsistatic.com/i/r/2026/10/05/705fb63e-5c8f-4c10-b8d0-9d657b427b5a/thumbnail/670x377/23f59faea79a2cdd648c7f9760375208/untitled-design-2026-10-05t202450-424.png"><img class="" alt="untitled-design-2026-10-05t202450-424.png" src="https://sportshub.cbsistatic.com/i/r/2026/10/05/705fb63e-5c8f-4c10-b8d0-9d657b427b5a/resize/670x377/b1ff37043f1fda807cdedefbf2b12872/untitled-design-2026-10-05t202450-424.png" loading="lazy" height="377" width="670"></div><figcaption class="MediaShortcode-figcaption"><span class="MediaShortcode-credit">
                                                                    Getty Images
                                                            </span></figcaption></figure><p>The U.S. men's national team's next generation continues to go from strength to strength, passing the first notable test of their international careers in a <a href="https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/usmnt-vs-mexico-score-live-updates-as-usa-soccer-meet-el-tri-in-rivalry-showdown/live/">3-0 win against longtime rivals Mexico</a>.</p>
        <div id="article-body-ad-0" class="native-story-ad"><div id="native_story_flex_top" class="ad-native-story-flex-top " data-ad="native-story-flex-top" data-ad-unit="native_story_flex_top"></div></div>
<p>USMNT head coach Mauricio Pochettino leaned on experience with eight World Cup players in his starting lineup, but the three newcomers each impressed in their own right, coming up with much-needed plays to get through a game that posed more challenges than the scoreline indicated. <em>El Tri</em> imposed from the start, their high-intensity approach out of the gate, forcing the U.S. team to lack any sort of composure in the early moments of the game. Mexico, though, lacked the one thing the U.S. did not: a clinical edge. The opening goal was a microcosm of the game -- Julian Hall had four touches by the 27th minute and the USMNT had just one shot, but the 18-year-old's ability to find the right space at the right time meant his fifth touch handed his team an edge they may not have otherwise earned.</p><p>Pochettino's side turned things around after halftime, though Mexico's first shot on target was impressively stopped by goalkeeper Diego Kochen in the second half. As <em>El Tri</em>'s mistakes piled up, though, the USMNT took advantage. Cavan Sullivan notched his first international goal in style in the 62nd minute by chipping goalkeeper Raul Rangel from distance, while Mateo Chavez's two-handed slap on Sebastian Berhalter five minutes later sent <em>El Tri</em> into disarray. Not to be outdone by the youngsters, Malik Tillman scored minutes before the final whistle to confirm a commanding, well-earned victory that showcased the U.S. team's ability to troubleshoot.</p><ul><li><strong>Pochettino:</strong> <em>"I think it was a good lesson, the first half, because it was the sense to work all together, suffer together. When you are not playing well or in the way that you plan to play, I think it's so important to show that maturity like a team, like a group of players. The 11 players plus the players that were outside, they were suffering all together. It was that connection."</em></li></ul><p>Pochettino has been careful to create a low-pressure setting for the group of 13 players who were uncapped at the start of the international break, going as far as <a href="https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/usmnt-mexico-el-tri-live-stream-mauricio-pochettino/">downplaying the stakes of the U.S.' intense rivalry with Mexico</a> pre-match. Pressure, though, invites itself, and sharing a pitch with an intense Mexico team that had the backing of the crowd of 60,000-plus, it was hard for the U.S. team <em>not</em> to feel it. They admirably solved the problems they faced, though, so far living up to the billing as the USMNT's brightest talents yet. Pochettino has tried not to single out any individuals as part of his plans to "protect" the newcomers, but praise for Sullivan's game was wriggled out of him on Saturday, describing the 17-year-old as a "warrior" and "fighter" as well as complimenting the whole group on understanding the tactical non-negotiables he and his coaching staff have set, all of it on display against Mexico.</p>
        <div id="article-body-ad-1" class="gambling-partner-ad"><div id="gambling_partner_flex_article" class="ad-gambling-partner-flex-article GamblingPartnerAd lazyload lazypreload" data-ad="gambling-partner-flex-article" data-ad-unit="gambling_partner_flex_article"></div></div>
<p>Nearly as far away from a World Cup as it gets, a loss on Saturday -- or at any stage of this international break -- was always going to be survivable for the USMNT. The fact that they came out of their clash against Mexico with a hard-fought, well-earned win, though, makes this early stop on the road to the 2030 World Cup a barometer for what's to come. The measuring stick for this version of the USMNT effectively begins with Saturday's game and the results, at least so far, continue to be promising.</p><h3>📺 What We're Watching</h3><figure class="MediaShortcode MediaShortcodeImage none large"><div class="MediaShortcodeImage-image" data-large="https://sportshub.cbsistatic.com/i/r/2025/10/20/95ead6c2-6ba0-49ec-ad8f-74881947fca0/thumbnail/670x377/b8cff161c59dcc84ae83a3f1e35c900f/ucl-channel-hq-slate.png"><img class="" alt="ucl-channel-hq-slate.png" src="https://sportshub.cbsistatic.com/i/r/2025/10/20/95ead6c2-6ba0-49ec-ad8f-74881947fca0/resize/670x377/d4e8a170d1eca9040d5ac6612d72fff5/ucl-channel-hq-slate.png" loading="lazy" height="377" width="670"></div></figure><h3>What's on CBS Sports Golazo Network</h3><p>☀️ <strong>Morning Footy</strong> (Weekdays 10 a.m. to 12 p.m.): Join Golazo Network as it helps fans get their day started on the right foot on the <a href="https://www.cbssports.com/watch/cbs-sports-golazo-network?ftag=CBS-03-10ade4e" target="_blank">network's flagship morning show</a> with highlights, interviews and the biggest soccer storylines. <a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/morning-footy-a-daily-soccer-podcast-from-cbs/id1694386891" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">Morning Footy is also available in podcast form</a>, so you'll never have to miss an episode.<br><br>3️⃣ <strong>Attacking Third</strong>: The leading women's <a href="https://podcasts.apple.com/us/podcast/attacking-third-a-cbs-sports-soccer-podcast/id1573642138" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">soccer podcast</a> and <a href="https://www.tiktok.com/discover/Attacking-third" target="_blank" rel="nofollow">social brand</a> is now a live studio show.
